model.summary: allenai/OLMoE-1B-7B-0924 (olmoe, qwen2_moe): 16/16 MoE layers, E=64 H=2048 I=1024, top-8; 6.44B expert + 0.48B dense params

performance.statement: not predicted: no performance model is calibrated for this backend yet; the ordering below rests on measured relative speeds, not on a time estimate

reasons: experts4bit: kernel paged_graphs not usable here: the fused FP8 KV append casts to e4m3 in Triton, which needs sm_89+; this device is sm_86
experts4bit: vram_gb sized to 0.000, the largest the device budget allows
experts4bit: dram_gb sized to 0.000, the largest the host budget allows
all experts resident (placement all-vram): 7.68 GiB estimated + 0.53 GiB headroom fits the 10.65 GiB budget
KV pool 1.08 GiB for 4 sequences x 4096 tokens; it scales linearly in both

kernels: paged FP8 KV pool + attention, f32 compute (fp8 compute needs sm_89+, fp8_paged_attn.fp8_compute_unsupported); grouped NF4 / int4 decode routes as serve_paged resolves them (reported at /health)

first-chunk prefill graph off (the server's default is auto): its private pool is not priced (SC2b measured +3.3 GiB at Qwen3-30B), so the plan's memory would not bound the process; fix prefill_graph=auto to let the server engage it when that much is free

experts on the int4-b32 grid (exp_int4, round-to-nearest): repacked at load from the source checkpoint, which must be on local disk and is read whole; the repack holds 4.50 GiB of host memory at its peak, one layer in fp32 at a time, and the process keeps most of it after load
not planned yet: a measured routing profile for the solver, decode speed

to serve it: E4B_INT4_KEEP_NF4=0 E4B_PAGED_BUCKETS=1,2,4,8,16 E4B_PAGED_CHUNK_TOKENS=512 E4B_PAGED_DRAM_GB=6.0 E4B_PAGED_GRAPHS=0 E4B_PAGED_HOT_ROWS=64 E4B_PAGED_KV_GROUPS=auto E4B_PAGED_MAX_SEQS=4 E4B_PAGED_MAX_TOKENS_PER_SEQ=4096 E4B_PAGED_PLACEMENT=all-vram E4B_PAGED_PREFILL_GRAPH=0 E4B_PAGED_VRAM_GB=1.2 E4B_SERVE_ATTN_INT4=0 E4B_SERVE_EXP_INT4=1 python -m experts4bit_qlora.serve_paged (with the model's arena and calibration)
